_comment: FROZEN evaluation surface — reviewer-only, NEVER model-visible. Uploaded FRESH at scoring under /tests together with heldout_corpus.jsonl / heldout_queries.jsonl / heldout_qrels.json (2026-07-27: those three were removed from the image, where a root solver could read the relevance labels). compute_reward.py reads thresholds from here. | 2026-07-27: reward is the reward.md 性能类 envelope and ref_speedup is now the frozen authoring-time constant 1.4290238072817099 (see ref_speedup).
base_embedding_model_baked: sentence-transformers/all-MiniLM-L6-v2 (384-dim; downloaded at Docker build via proxy, frozen under /opt/models)
heldout_data_provenance: WikiText-103（构建期经代理下载，离线切分）。语料 = 段落正文，留出查询 = 从源段落摘出的最长句，其源段落是唯一 gold（rel=1）。⚠️ 2026-07-26 反捷径修复：**每一个**段落（不只是被查询的那些）都摘掉了它最长的那句，只把剩余正文写进语料 —— 所以 gold 文档不再逐字包含 query（构建期自证 leakage=0/N，见镜像构建日志），一个「子串/精确短语匹配」打分器拿不到分；同时因为全语料一致地摘句，也没有「gold 段落系统性更短」的长度捷径。agent 可见的 dev split（/data）与留出 TEST split 段落池互斥。

calibration_evidence.note: strong_baseline_ndcg = 强基线参考解在 held-out 上 5 次重复的中位数（eval-only，确定性）

reward_formula: reward = min(1.0, ln(ratio/ref_speedup)/ln(ref_speedup)) if ratio > ref_speedup else 0.0; range [0,1]; ratio = candidate_ndcg / strong_baseline_ndcg

ref_speedup.provenance: authoring-time CPU-lane measurement of the best IN-BUDGET variant (32 dims x float16 = 64 B/vector, full-precision shortlist refiner): nDCG@10 = 0.6561377101372043 against strong_baseline_ndcg = 0.459151 -> ratio = 1.4290238072817099. The same session measured the strong-baseline anchor 5/5 identical (sigma = 0). The oracle is NEVER run at scoring time — this is a read-only constant.
ref_speedup.metric_kind_caveat: reward.md 性能类 公式定义在 wall-clock speedup 上；本题不计时，喂进 ln() 的是 64 B/向量 预算下的 nDCG@10 质量比。2026-07-27 owner 裁定：**保留有界 log 公式，不改判二值** —— 天花板 1.429 远高于 1.15 下限、σ=0、条件良好，而二值化会毁掉真实梯度（naive 0.319→0.0 / 基线 1.0000011→1.5e-06 / oracle 1.42902→0.5 / 封顶还差 2× ratio）。修的是**命名不是 reward**：`speedup`/`ref_speedup` 保留 reward.md 的字段名以兼容下游校验，另外**新增** metric_kind="quality_ratio"、metric_name="ndcg@10"、metric_direction="higher_is_better"、timing_measured=false，杜绝把 1.429 读成时延比。
ref_speedup.conditioning: ln(1.4290238072817099) = 0.3570047 -> reward 0.5 exactly at the demonstrated in-budget ceiling (nDCG@10 = 0.6561377); reward caps at 1.0 only at ratio 1.42902^2 = 2.042109 (nDCG@10 = 0.937637), which is above the out-of-budget 384-d fp32 ruler (0.6918612) and therefore unreachable; the strong baseline (ratio 1.0) scores 0.
ref_speedup.reference_implementation: task/solution/submission_encoder_ceiling_ref.py — re-archived 2026-07-27 with the same fingerprint (PCA-32 + float16 = 64 B/vec + full-precision shortlist refiner) so the constant can be re-measured; reviewer-only, never in the image.
ref_speedup.hardware_caveat: 此 ref_speedup=1.4290238072817099 与 thresholds.strong_baseline_ndcg=0.459151 在作者的 CPU 通道(Intel Sapphire Rapids)上标定。本题主指标是检索质量(nDCG@10)而非墙钟时间,只要语料可复现就与硬件无关 —— build 时会断言重生成的 heldout_* 与题包 tests/ 逐字节一致。若你改了语料、底座嵌入模型(/opt/models/all-MiniLM-L6-v2)或字节预算,请按 recalibrate_howto 重标。

recalibrate_howto.step1: docker run --rm -v "$PWD/tests:/tests:ro" -e VERIFIER_MODE=<模式名> fai/e2e-g2-embed-compress-golf:oss bash /tests/test.sh
recalibrate_howto.step2: 从 /logs/verifier/benchmark_results.json 读 ndcg / gain(建议 >=3 次取中位数)
recalibrate_howto.guard: ref_speedup <= 1 或缺失 => 设计上 HARD FAIL 0
recalibrate_howto.answer_key_warning: tests/heldout_qrels.json 就是相关性答案key:它随题包开源、但绝不能烤进镜像(否则可造 64 字节签名编码器把 gold 钉在 top-1)

heldout_assets.location: uploaded fresh with tests/ to /tests (NOT baked into the image any more)
heldout_assets.provenance: extracted byte-for-byte from the pushed image e2e-g2-embed-compress-golf-val:v0@sha256:6a2321f8aae9c5d66453198d0cdcd051c74ff6a8a80621e30c9a95939bc6ff78 layer sha256:e8e44901202f19703414346ac7afac78bf0c4a846d3592f156666a48c7a1346c (/opt/verifier/) — i.e. EXACTLY the split strong_baseline_ndcg=0.459151 and ref_speedup=1.4290238072817099 were calibrated on. Do not regenerate.
